probe.text_sample: Decimals — A scout network for hiring designers D E C I M A L S How it works Placements Become a Scout Blog Get started Log in Hire designers who care through scouts that can tell A scout network for hiring designers Get started How it works From our network, hired by What you get Find the best designer out there, not just in your inbox Every portfolio has been reviewed by a scout the community respects. So you're meeting designers chosen for the quality of their work “Everyone you get is designer good, not just recruiter good” David Flowers , Lead Product Designer Hiring Manager Skip straight to the shortlist You'll get a curated handful worth meeting, with your feedback refining each round, right in Slack and the hiring tools you already use “You have the private signal of elite designers who are interested. That's something I couldn't find on my own” Daniel Zarick , CEO Hiring Manager Review handpicked intros Every intro comes through a scout the designer already respects. You ask to meet, they choose to accept, so the conversation starts with real interest on both sides “With every recruiter I've worked with, you go through weeks of calibration. Decimal

vibe.evidence: The page uses a light color palette with ample whitespace, sans-serif typography, and clean layouts. The imagery is primarily photographic with a subtle illustrative overlay. The overall aesthetic is uncluttered and professional, leaning towards a minimalist and magazine-like style.
